writeLease.canonicalization: UTF-8 JSON; ensure_ascii=false; sort_keys=true; separators=(',',':'); SHA-256

forbiddenWrites: live runtime, bin, Task Scheduler or public state

requiredAmendment.purpose: L7 must bind the complete post-install runtime closure and both current Scheduled Task actions, not one launcher file
installedAuthorityRequired: installedClosure exact sorted rows path,sha256,bytes for launcher, runner, timeout wrapper, daily_self_heal, completion_guard, daily_control and audit_recovery_control
installedClosureSha256 over the exact sorted closure rows
bindings exact high-cost and recovery-runtime rows with schemaVersion,relativePath,sha256 and bindingsSha256
taskActions exact bootstrap and production structured actions plus each actionSha256 and taskActionsSha256
ownerReceipts exact runtime_generation_owner and ops_install_owner records using the S5 authority schemas/hashes/preimages plus ownerReceiptsSha256
requiredAmendment.fixtureMaterialization: create deterministic files only under each pytest tmp installed root; copy tracked production bytes for the seven closure paths and write sealed synthetic binding JSON there; do not read or mutate machine installed paths
requiredAmendment.s5Boundary: update the real L7 S5 authority fixture to carry both canonically sealed ownerReceipts required by S5B; derive its installedClosure/task action hashes from actual staged bytes and TaskAdapter registered definition, never a self-reported boolean
requiredAmendment.validatorContract: the unchanged release APIs must exact-validate all new installed authority fields for validate_layer_evidence, admit_final_e2e and validate_natural_evidence

negativeCoverage: closure row missing, unknown, duplicate, unsorted, path escape, byte drift and sha drift with correct outer reseal
high-cost binding and recovery binding schema/hash drift
bootstrap action and production action executable/argv/workingDirectory/hash drift
one owner missing, receipt schema drift, inner receipt hash drift, preimage substitution and owner aggregate hash drift
all semantic negatives recursively reseal containing hashes; hash-drift remains a separate case
testDesignRules: retain exactly six existing top-level node names and dynamically import tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_release first so Red cause remains absent module
amend shared helpers/fixture cases rather than add count-only nodes
do not encode the production validator implementation or accept source-text-only evidence
preserve the corrected L3-L9 real boundary, history and non-substitution assertions
no network, external model, live Task Scheduler, UAC, publication, credentials or non-temp mutation

verification.red: py -3.12 -m pytest --noconftest -q tests/test_news_grasp_cleanroom_s6_release.py; expect exactly six failures caused only by absent tools.news_grasp_cleanroom_release
verification.diff: git diff --check plus exact two owned paths only

commitPolicy.message: test: bind S6 installed runtime closure

causalRetry: one test-authoring attempt and one causal retry only; stop on collection error, unexpected Green or non-module Red without weakening
delivery: two hashes/bytes, exact six Red, coverage map, commit and clean status
stopPolicy: return to Sol; no production implementation
